pages.text: Once you save up enough coins, search for the Special Merchant. He spawns outside villages all across the world.$(br)$(br)His stock $(l)depends directly on the biome$() you find him in!

pages.title: Ice Rod
pages.text: Sold in Winter biomes. The most affordable custom rod.$(br)$(br)$(l)Passive:$() No special biome bonus.

pages.title: Sand Rod
pages.text: Sold in Deserts. Mid-tier fishing rod.$(br)$(br)$(l)Passive:$() No special biome bonus.

pages.title: Jungle Rod
pages.text: Sold in the Jungle.$(br)$(br)$(l)Passive:$() No special biome bonus.

pages.title: Swamp Rod
pages.text: Sold exclusively in Swamps.$(br)$(br)$(l)Passive (Swamp):$() In swamp biomes, bait is consumed 50% less often.

pages.text: Sold in Mushroom Fields. The ultimate fishing rod.$(br)$(br)$(l)Passive (Mushroom):$() 25% chance to catch a copy of the fish (double catch).
